settings.cellContentFunction: let color = '#757575'; let backColor = '#F5F5F5'; let text = value; if (value === 'closed') { color = '#E8F5E9'; backColor = '#2E7D32'; text = 'Closed'; } else if (value === 'tripped') { color = '#FFEBEE'; backColor = '#C62828'; text = 'Tripped'; } else if (value === 'open') { color = '#FFF3E0'; backColor = '#EF6C00'; text = 'Open'; } return `${text}`;
let color = '#757575'; let backColor = '#F5F5F5'; let text = 'Inactive'; if (value == 'true' || value == true) { text = 'Active'; color = '#E8EAF6'; backColor = '#303F9F'; } return `${text}`;

barColor.colorFunction: if (typeof value === 'number') { if (value > 13500) return '#F44336'; if (value > 10500) return '#FF9800'; return '#4CAF50'; } return '#bdbdbd';
